# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting T3 Pretty to the fork maintainer via GitHub Security
Advisories at https://github.com/SergeSerb2/t3-pretty/security/advisories or by contacting the
repository owner. Please do not disclose them publicly until the maintainer has had a reasonable
opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

Report vulnerabilities affecting upstream T3 Code or T3 Tools-operated infrastructure to
[security@ping.gg](mailto:security@ping.gg). Please do not disclose them publicly until T3 Tools has
had a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

See the [full upstream security policy](https://t3.codes/security-policy) for reporting details,
scope, and safe harbor terms for good-faith research.
